title: Dimensions in Time (1)
best: 576i broadcast; unreached, every surviving copy is an off-air recording
best_reported: Never released on any format: an Equity agreement bars reuse and Children in Need licensing is quoted at 6,000 pounds a minute. Tested and rejected: a 854x480 YouTube "remaster" cropped from 4:3 to 16:9, a 352x272 correctly-timed pair, a 1280x1080 AI upscale, and a fan DVD with no seeders
source: archive.org the-curse-of-fatal-death-and-dimensions-in-time | off-air capture; the Children in Need studio link trimmed, in at 107.20 s as it fades
description: Several Doctors and their companions are pulled out of their own times and dropped into Albert Square, where the Rani has set a trap. The residents carry on as the travellers flicker between years around them.

title: Doctor Who: The Movie
best: 2160p UHD disc, 2026 restoration
description: The Doctor is carrying the Master's remains home to Gallifrey when the TARDIS is forced down in San Francisco, days before the millennium. A surgeon who has never seen two hearts is about to lose him, and the Master is already looking for a new body.

title: Doctor Who and the Curse of Fatal Death
best: 576i, the 1999 VHS; unreached, no clean transfer of it is in circulation
best_reported: 576i broadcast 12 March 1999 in four parts; official VHS 6 September 1999 in two parts, no DVD. No four-part source survives - the official upload is one continuous edit
source: YouTube | Comic Relief official channel, Do-wDPoC6GM, 854x480 native; its 720p and 1080p are YouTube AI upscales. The 704x576 fan DVD ISO was tested and rejected: a VHS capture, noise not detail
description: The Master lures the Doctor to Tersurus for a final reckoning, having spent centuries arranging the sewers beneath it. Both keep going back to bribe the same architect, and the Doctor is expected at his own wedding.

title: Death Comes to Time (1)
best: 256x144, the native RealPix stills; nothing higher was ever made
best_reported: RealAudio plus RealPix stills, 13 July 2001 to 3 May 2002, five episodes confirmed by the 2004 MP3-CD disc itself (Episode1-5.html). The disc art measures 256x144, the logo 384x216, so every copy larger than that is an upscale
source: archive.org doctor-who-bbci-webcasts-death-comes-to-time-real-time-shada | reconstruction of the slideshow. description: The Doctor and Ace are drawn into a war in which Time Lords act openly as gods and one of them has taken a side. The rules the Doctor has lived by are being broken by his own people, and somebody is counting the cost.
